lines.1: 「All right. Then I will go next.」
lines.8: 「Aren't you going to crush an apple in one hand or something?」
lines.9: 「A maiden like me could never do such a thing!」
lines.10: Otome squeezed. The apple burst apart in her hand.
lines.13: 「My performance is a magic trick. Let me see... I shall use this ten-yen coin.」
lines.14: 「I will make this single ten-yen coin multiply into two.」
lines.15: She clenched the coin tightly in her palm.
lines.21: 「It is supposed to multiply... Why will it not work?」
lines.22: Getting angry at us wasn't going to help...
lines.23: 「My apologies. I have not trained enough.」
lines.24: Otome closed her fist around the coin in bitter disappointment.
lines.25: ...The ten-yen coin had been folded neatly in two.
lines.26: 「Wow! Incredible again! You folded it in half!」
lines.27: 「You truly are unfathomable... I couldn't do that.」
lines.29: 「Why choose magic when you're so clumsy with your hands?」
lines.32: 「One day, I will show you the trick performed successfully.」
lines.33: Everyone else had enjoyed it, but Otome looked frustrated.
lines.35: 「Leo, do you not have a girlfriend?」
lines.37: 「Why are you answering for me? And why do you look so happy about it?」
lines.39: 「Though Leo is a member of the Erika Kiriya fan club.」
lines.42: 「I see. So the Princess is your type, Leo.」
lines.43: 「I wouldn't say she's my type... It's more like I admire her.」
lines.44: 「We're all rooting for Leo's love life, though.」
lines.45: 「Granted, his target is the Princess, but he's shy about this stuff. Watching him drag his feet is driving us crazy.」
lines.47: Otome seemed to consider that for a while before looking up.
lines.48: 「For all your carrying on, it is good to see that you are such close friends.」
lines.49: 「...There is somewhere I would like to take all of you after school on Monday. Will you wait for me in your classroom?」
lines.51: 「You can look forward to finding out when we arrive.」
lines.53: ...And with that, our rather enjoyable welcome party came to an end.
